name: Befoe
body:
School enchantment (charm) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, mesmerist 1, occultist 1, psychic 1, shaman 1, skald 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1; Focus opportunist 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 hour/level (D)
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause the target to dislike you. At the time of casting, you may choose to turn its attitude towards you either unfriendly or hostile. On a successful saving throw, the duration is reduced to 1 minute per level. The target is not blind nor single-minded in its newfound hatred but is willing to harm you without provocation when given the opportunity, within the limits of its alignment. The spell causes a strictly personal vendetta towards you; attitudes towards your allies aren’t besmirched by association.
